note: Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey page header states "Total Shipments 82 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 1", "Ports 2"; the free view exposed only 5 dated shipment rows (1 export to Nepal, 4 imports from Italy/China/Poland). Export is confirmed by a single dated customs line (2025-09-23, LCS Nepalgunj Road -> NEPAL, HS 84221900, B/L 8990556) — this matches the declared HS 842219 (dishwashing machines of the household type), so no HS correction is needed. The bulk of the 82 records are imports (GIADOS INTERNATIONAL SRL, REPA ITALIA S.R.L., GUDELUCK (DONGGUAN), NINGBO DONGQIAN LAKE / KROME DISPENSE), i.e. the company is an importer-distributor of industrial kitchen/dishwashing equipment that also re-exports to Nepal and Sri Lanka. Domestic India supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and volza.com / eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views — recorded as null, not estimated.
